name: kiro
description: Claude/Codex plans and verifies, Kiro CLI implements and reviews on subscription credits — a cost-savings delegation workflow using an isolated git worktree and scope-guarded diffs

interface.shortDescription: Delegate implementation and review to Kiro CLI to save tokens.
interface.longDescription: Plan with Codex, hand off implementation tasks to Kiro CLI (flat-rate subscription credits) inside an isolated git worktree, verify with tests, and gate every commit behind a Kiro-run review. Falls back to the host writing the code when Kiro's fix-loop is exhausted.
defaultPrompt: Review my staged changes with Kiro before I commit.
